chunks: Al-Shaykh, may Allah have mercy on him, informed me, saying: Ja'far ibn Muhammad ibn Qulawayh informed me, from Muhammad ibn Ya'qub, from 'Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from 'Abd Allah ibn al-Mughirah, from Sa'id al-A'raj.
He said: I asked Aba 'Abd Allah عليه السلام about the leftover water of the Jew and the Christian, and he said: No.

key_terms.أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq عليه السلام, the Imam being asked
key_terms.النَّصْرَانِيِّ: a Christian, mentioned here alongside the Jew in the same legal ruling
key_terms.الْيَهُودِيِّ: a Jew, mentioned here as the subject of a ruling on leftover water
key_terms.سُؤْرِ: leftover drink or water remaining after someone has drunk from it
key_terms.لَا: a negative answer indicating disallowance or prohibition in this context

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Abu 'Abd Allah عليه السلام rule about the leftover water of a Jew or a Christian?
ai.summary: This hadith transmits a legal ruling from Imam Abu 'Abd Allah عليه السلام regarding the use of the leftover drink or water touched by a Jew or a Christian. The Imam's concise reply indicates prohibition in the context asked about, making the narration relevant to fiqh discussions of ritual purity and impurity.
